Safe Inside: how to stop chasing safety outside yourself

Live online · 60 minutes · Replay for 48 hours · [Date and time]

Sound familiar?

Always looking for safety outside yourself?

  • You look for safety in other people, plans and reassurance, and the calm never lasts long.
  • You catch yourself seeking reassurance, over-planning or people-pleasing, even when you can see the pattern.
  • You have read so much about this, but knowing it in your head is not the same as feeling it in your body.
  • You want to feel steady inside yourself, and to show up that way with the people closest to you.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

What self-safety really means

The difference between feeling safe because everything outside is calm, and feeling steady inside yourself.

02

Why we chase safety

The everyday patterns of seeking reassurance, over-planning and people-pleasing, and where they come from.

03

Listening to your body

A simple way to notice what your body is telling you, without judging it or trying to fix it straight away.

04

Safety in relationships

How self-safety changes the way you show up with the people closest to you.

05

Your next step

How the Complete Self-Safety Program works, so you can decide if going deeper with Jackie is right for you.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

Anyone who finds themselves looking for safety in other people, plans and reassurance, and wants to learn how to build it from the inside.

Is it really free?

Yes. Your seat, the live Q&A, the daily self-safety check-in guide and the 48-hour replay are all free.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay for 48 hours, so you can watch it when it suits you.

How long is it?

60 minutes, live online, with a live Q&A with Jackie.

What happens after the class?

At the end Jackie explains how the Complete Self-Safety Program works, so you can decide if going deeper with her is right for you.

Is this therapy or medical advice?

No. It is educational content, not medical advice. This class is not therapy and does not replace care from your own healthcare provider.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The reassurance loop"

Hook
"Reassurance works for about ten minutes. Then the search starts again. Here's why." (to camera, soft natural light, the same look as your profile)
Body
"A lot of us learned to look for safety outside ourselves: in other people's moods, in having a plan for everything, in hearing that it's going to be okay. Self-safety is about building that feeling from the inside, so it comes with you." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach where to start in a free 60-minute class called Safe Inside. Tap Sign up to save your seat. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three small self-safety practices"

Hook
"Three small self-safety practices I'd start this week if I were new to all of this." (Jackie holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: a three-minute body check-in when you wake up. Two: name what you're feeling before you reach for your phone. Three: one evening moment of stillness to settle the day. Small, free, and they make the next steps easier." (caption for each practice)
CTA
"I go through the full approach in my free masterclass. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me whether to start with my content, my store, a session or my program. Here's my honest answer." (walking outside, morning light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't decide yet. Come to my free masterclass first. You'll learn how I think about self-safety, try a few practices that week, and know which next step fits you."
CTA
"It's called Safe Inside, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
